purpose: Cheaply lint proof command text before it enters the proof broker. The preflight emits deterministic guidance and never executes the command being inspected.

warm_target_command_matrix.canonical_command_shape: rustfmt --edition 2024 --check <paths> OR git diff --check -- <paths> OR jq empty <json_paths> OR bash -n <scripts>
reuse_safety_constraints: May be used as lightweight evidence without RCH or Cargo execution.
Must not be cited as compile or runtime proof.
prefer_narrower_proof_when: The active change is docs-only, JSON-only, shell-only, or Rust formatting-only.

warm_target_command_matrix.canonical_command_shape: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_<safe_bead_id>_<intent> CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --lib <test_filter> -- --nocapture
reuse_safety_constraints: Target dir must contain the normalized bead id.
Reuse only for the same package, test filter, toolchain, rustflags, and changed source set.
prefer_narrower_proof_when: A single library unit regression covers the modified branch.
An all-targets job is already running for another bead.

examples.command: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_bd_7eefz_async_gen CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --lib async_generator_next_fails_closed_for_suspended_body -- --nocapture

warm_target_command_matrix.canonical_command_shape: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_<safe_bead_id>_<test_name> CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --test <test_target> <test_filter> -- --nocapture
reuse_safety_constraints: Target dir must contain the normalized bead id.
Reuse only when the same integration target, filter, toolchain, rustflags, and fixtures are unchanged.
prefer_narrower_proof_when: A named integration test exercises the changed user-facing contract.

examples.command: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_bd_example_it_eval_pipeline CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --test eval_pipeline_integration quickjs_eval_array_ -- --nocapture

warm_target_command_matrix.canonical_command_shape: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_<safe_bead_id>_all_targets CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo check --all-targets
reuse_safety_constraints: Target dir must contain the normalized bead id.
Prefer one active all-targets proof per branch when the queue is saturated.
Do not treat timeouts without compiler diagnostics as code failures.
prefer_narrower_proof_when: A focused lib or integration proof covers the touched behavior.
There is already an active all-targets RCH job for the branch.

examples.command: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_bd_zy517_all_targets CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo check --all-targets

warm_target_command_matrix.canonical_command_shape: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_<safe_bead_id>_clippy_all_targets CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
reuse_safety_constraints: Target dir must contain the normalized bead id.
Use after focused checks or when the change touches shared lint-sensitive API surface.
prefer_narrower_proof_when: The change is confined to docs, shell, JSON, or a focused unit branch.

examples.command: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_bd_example_clippy_clippy_all_targets CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

warm_target_command_matrix.canonical_command_shape: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_<safe_bead_id>_release CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 <release-grade cargo command>
reuse_safety_constraints: Target dir must contain the normalized bead id.
Use only for release readiness or cross-crate proof, not for routine narrow changes.
Record the exact command and artifact path in the evidence ledger.
prefer_narrower_proof_when: The active bead is not release-prep or cross-crate validation.

examples.command: rch exec -- env RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rch_target_franken_engine_bd_example_release_release CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS='-C linker=cc' CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test

remediation_requirements: Every non-proof-safe decision emits remediation text.
Every heavy cargo rejection emits a pasteable direct rch exec -- env command when a cargo suffix can be extracted.
Unsupported env remediation lists rejected env names.
